camel_example: aliyun quickbi-public CreateTicket4AiPro --region cn-hangzhou --AiProId test --version 2022-01-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Generates an AIPro Super Box embedding ticket
name: CreateTicket4AiPro

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AIPro embedding configuration. The configuration must exist, belong to the current organization, and have a status of 1
parameters.help_zh: AIPro 嵌入配置 ID；配置须存在、属于当前组织且 status=1
parameters.name: ai_pro_id

parameters.help_en: The number of times the ticket can be used. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 99999
parameters.help_zh: 票据可使用次数，默认 1，取值 1～99999
parameters.name: ticket_num

parameters.help_en: The QuickBI user ID of the access user to bind. Specify either this parameter or the combination of AccountName and AccountType
parameters.help_zh:
绑定访问用户的 QuickBI userId；
与accountName+accountType 二选一
parameters.name: quick_bi_user_id

parameters.help_en: The account of the access user to bind. Use this parameter together with AccountType when QuickBIUserId is not specified
parameters.help_zh:
绑定访问用户账号；
userId 未传时配合 accountType 使用
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The account type of the user. Valid values:
1: Alibaba Cloud account.
3: Quick BI custom account.
4: DingTalk.
5: RAM user.
9: WeCom
parameters.help_zh:
用户的账号类型。

1：阿里云账号
3：Quick BI 自建账号
4：钉钉
5：RAM 子账号
9：企业微信
parameters.name: account_type

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the ticket, in minutes. Default value: 240. The value must be greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 有效期，单位分钟，默认 240，必须大于 0
parameters.name: expire_time

parameters.help_en: The custom system identifier. The length must be less than 150 characters
parameters.help_zh: 自定义系统标识，长度小于 150
parameters.name: system_uid

parameters.help_en: The custom pass-through parameter. If specified, it must be a valid JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 自定义透传参数，非空时必须为合法 JSON 字符串
parameters.name: custom_param

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功

true -- 成功
false -- 失败
